I replied in #coastal-team to Bettina. I didn't set up the recurring Monday 08:00 digest. I have no way to post into Slack on a schedule, so the digest would only go out when someone asks me for it.

I didn't check the scheduling tool before saying that. There is a cron tool in this workspace, but its jobs run locally and don't deliver to Slack, so it can't post there either. Someone with access to the Slack integration would need to set up the schedule.
